args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/beach sandals
- Hiking shoes/sturdy footwear for Diamond Head
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof dry bag for valuables
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

Hiking & Outdoor Gear:
- Day backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Hiking socks
- Moisture-wicking shirts
- Quick-dry shorts/pants
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Waterproof camera (optional)

Toiletries:
- Travel-sized shampoo/conditioner
- Body wash
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Personal medications
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

Miscellaneous:
- Books/e-reader for relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Snacks for day trips
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

Activities-Specific Items:
- Pearl Harbor: Comfortable shoes, respectful attire
- Luau: Hawaiian shirt/dress (optional but fun)
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Shopping: Reusable shopping bags
